description: This file provides a utility function 'apiGet' for making HTTP GET requests with centralized URL handling, authorization headers, and organization ID appending. It includes helper functions for URL construction and configuration-based base URL resolution.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base API URL from configuration, environment variables, or defaults to '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Joins a base URL with a relative or absolute path, handling /api prefix and origin root.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl
methods.description: Appends organization_id parameter to URL if available and not already present.
